difficulty_reason: H2: the counted author proof compares the products of generic residue fields before and after completion, uses generic etaleness to control the total fraction algebra and injects the completed original integral closure into the finite normalization over the completed Nagata base. Noetherian submodule finiteness and faithfully flat descent then yield finite normalization over the original merely analytically unramified base. The nonroutine generic-field/normalization comparison is in this own proofresolve.tex2921-2966, not outsourced to optional background; no independent correctness certification.

compared.relation: Normality on the complement of the special fibre after completion gives finiteness AND compatibility with completion; present assumption is analytic unramifiedness of base plus generic etaleness of source, without that normal-away-special-fibre assumption or compatibility conclusion.
Requires a regular alteration of an integral scheme; present conditional result uses completion of local base and generic etaleness, without an alteration.
Locally algebraic scheme over a field, with birationality and reduced-case statements; present base is arbitrary analytically unramified local Noetherian ring and generic-etale family.
Relative normalization over Nagata base; current base need not be Nagata and proof passes only its completion to a Nagata ring.

One-dimensional reduced Nagata local ring and commutation with henselization/completion; current scheme finiteness under different base/generic-etale hypotheses, no dimension-one or general commutation assertion.
